title: Migrate CI and release automation to native Buildkite pipeline-as-code
intent: Add a canonical .buildkite/pipeline.yml that explicitly models pull-request, master-push, release-PR, and tag-release behavior, preserves file-sensitive gates, and resolves the native Buildkite failures observed on merge commit bf98ec2e8320400964a1e84af0cc50210ac2fa6c without broad GitHub Actions workflow redesign.
proof_hooks: buildkite pipeline YAML parse and structural validation
GitHub and Buildkite checks for the published PR
